Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
Abjure
Cardtype: Power
Virtue: Redemption
[COMBAT] Tap this imbued before range is determined to end a combat
between a monster and a mortal. If the mortal is a minion other than
this imbued, you may move a conviction to this imbued from your hand
or
ash heap.

Can an incapacitated imbued still use Abjure (on a combat involving
other minions in the ready region, obviously)?

More broadly, if a combat card does not explicitly require a ready
vampire, can a vampire in torpor (or an incapacitated imbued) play it
during someone else's combat? (Save Face, Martyr's Resilience,
Infection, etc.)

-John Flournoy

Messages.Author: OrgPlay
Messages.Body:


6.4. Combat

Combat results when a minion blocks the action of a ready minion.
Also, some cards' effects may cause combat. Whatever caused the
combat, it is important to remember that only ready minions can
participate in combat and that your minions cannot enter combat with
any of your other minions.

IANLSJ
